main_measure.name: mean forecast-signed drift-adjusted 24-bar forward return on extreme grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases (and supporting difference > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: extreme minus other non-zero grid bars, mean signed drift-adjusted 24-bar return

decided_by: Main mean above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases and supporting difference (extreme minus rest) above 0.
reading: The grid is positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window with a full 24-bar forward return inside the window, the coin's mean 24-bar return is the mean of these grid returns over all its windows, and the situation check takes every non-zero volatility-scaled run as the situation with the expected side opposite to its sign.
